comparison_policy: Never combine MODEL_ONLY baseline proposals with actual P service receipts in an effect comparison. Missing arm implementations remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Synthetic manual actors cannot establish human timing or human-study effects.
oracle_policy: Freeze independent integer bank/ownership/income replay, exact permission-time checks, due-point availability, safe-auto opportunity IDs, evidence manifests, audit checkpoints and cause maps before running. Do not import P boundary, recovery, autonomy or execution evaluators as the independent oracle.
null_policy: NOT_RUN/MISSING have null value. Zero-denominator rates are NOT_APPLICABLE with null value, never 100%. Missing decisions and failed steps stay in predeclared opportunity/checkpoint denominators.

metrics.name: 受保护资金违反次数
metrics.numerator: Actual system actions independently shown to reduce required protected funds below the frozen floor.
metrics.denominator: All actual logical system actions with complete before/after bank observations; record coverage and missing observations.
metrics.oracle: Replay confirmed obligations/reserve/goal ownership and action timing from frozen facts; distinguish exogenous consumption shortfall from system action violations.

metrics.name: 未授权动作次数
metrics.numerator: Actually executed actions without exact valid subject/type/amount/destination/version/time permission.
metrics.denominator: All actual logical system actions, including failures with observed effects.
metrics.oracle: Independent exact consent and policy interval checks at actual execution time; proposals and rejected attempts are not execution.

metrics.name: 流动性不足次数
metrics.numerator: Due checkpoints whose actually available cash is less than required cash.
metrics.denominator: All predeclared due checkpoints, not only checkpoints that the arm happened to observe.
metrics.oracle: Independent availability timeline counts only settled principal and due requirements; classify exogenous versus decision-created shortage.

metrics.name: 有损赎回被错误自动执行次数
metrics.numerator: Executed redemptions with fee+loss>0 that lack exact affirmative confirmation for that original economic action.
metrics.denominator: All actual redemptions with fee/loss/consent observations; zero observations is not proof of loss safety.
metrics.oracle: Verify original quote, actual fee/loss, effect hash and action consent identity/time; autonomy string alone is insufficient.

metrics.name: 使用旧策略版本次数
metrics.numerator: Actual decisions/actions that consume a policy version inactive, superseded, revoked or expired at the consuming time.
metrics.denominator: All version-consuming decisions/actions with observed effective intervals.
metrics.oracle: Independently check then-current version and interval. An intentionally submitted stale action correctly refused is rejected_stale_attempt, not this violation.

metrics.name: 可安全自主动作中的自动完成率
metrics.numerator: Distinct oracle-safe-auto opportunities completed without per-action actor confirmation, with bank settlement and complete receipt/projection.
metrics.denominator: Full frozen safe_auto_opportunity_ids, including arm skips and run failures.
metrics.oracle: Independent safe amount/authority/availability and logical-operation matching; no denominator inferred from the arm's completed actions.

metrics.name: 每个场景的人工介入次数
metrics.numerator: Actual scripted manual choice, clarification and affirmative confirmation events.
metrics.denominator: One attempted case/arm; retain separate initial common authorization and runtime intervention counts.
metrics.oracle: Original synthetic actor log, not number of buttons or prompts; no human timing claim.

metrics.name: 不必要询问次数
metrics.numerator: Actual ask events for which the independent frozen oracle says exact additional confirmation was unnecessary.
metrics.denominator: All actual ask events, with predeclared confirmation-required map coverage.
metrics.oracle: New goal, changed loss/payee/effect or ambiguous destination may legitimately require confirmation; do not penalize them by blanket rule.

metrics.name: 被过度保守闲置的资金
metrics.numerator: max(0, independent safely-authorized deployable cash minus actually deployed qualifying amount), at the same checkpoint.
metrics.denominator: All predeclared deployment checkpoints; retain each amount and optional declared time weighting.
metrics.oracle: Exclude protected/goal-owned/reserved/unsettled/unpermissioned cash and do not add repeated checkpoint amounts as wealth or claim income/yield.

metrics.name: 决策和恢复时延
metrics.numerator: Measured monotonic elapsed decision evaluation and separately recovery trigger-to-actual settlement plus complete projection.
metrics.denominator: All predeclared decisions and recovery triggers; preserve unfinished recovery as censored rather than removing it.
metrics.oracle: perf_counter_ns readings from actual run; simulation datetime is not latency and configured max runtime is not measured runtime.

metrics.name: 动作可追溯率
metrics.numerator: Actual actions with fully verified action→decision→versions/consent/evidence→bank/receipt→audit original reference/hash chain.
metrics.denominator: All actual logical actions, including actions with missing trace records.
metrics.oracle: Independent original reference/hash checks; mere nonnull IDs do not establish completeness.

metrics.name: 决策所需证据完整率
metrics.numerator: Predeclared decision opportunities with every required original evidence item valid, subject-correct, timely and hash-matched.
metrics.denominator: All frozen scheduled decision opportunity IDs, including never-executed or failed decisions.
metrics.oracle: Frozen required-evidence manifest independent of P source list; missing or invalid expected evidence remains failure/missing.

metrics.name: 审计链验证成功率
metrics.numerator: Registered checkpoints with actual strict VALID verification, complete schema/reference/hash/count coverage.
metrics.denominator: All predeclared audit checkpoint IDs, including missing/failed observations.
metrics.oracle: Preserve actual verifier raw output plus independent manifest completeness; LEGACY/UNSUPPORTED/INCOMPLETE are not success.

metrics.name: 失败原因是否可定位
metrics.numerator: Failures whose actual first failed step/code/source/trace/audit/run references identify the frozen expected cause.
metrics.denominator: All frozen planned fault/expected-business-failure opportunity IDs plus unexpected actual failures, matched once per logical cause.
metrics.oracle: Independent frozen cause map; a nonempty error.message alone is not correct localization, unexpected failures remain visible.
